legal.name: Privacy policy
legal.why: the app stores learner data in Supabase, sends typed work to third-party AI providers, and loads a tracker — and its audience is 14-16 year olds

legal.name: Cookie policy
legal.why: the live site sets NO cookies (verified: no Set-Cookie header) and Vercel Analytics is cookieless — so this is a warn, and becomes a failure the day a real cookie or a non-cookieless tracker appears

legal.name: Refund policy
legal.why: not applicable while the app takes no payments — kept as a warning so it turns into a failure the day it does

_humanReview: REMOVE FAKE REVIEWS — no testimonials/ratings ship today. The day they do, they must be real: inventing them is illegal advertising, not a style choice.
FORM CONSENT — every form that collects personal data needs a clear, unticked opt-in next to it, and must say what the data is for. A script cannot tell a real consent checkbox from a decorative one.
ONLY COLLECT NECESSARY DATA — walk each field the app stores and ask 'would the app still work without this?' If yes, stop collecting it. This is a judgement call and always will be.
